docs.title: Job Posting: Front Desk Supervisor
docs.body:
Westbrook Hotel: Front Desk Supervisor

Westbrook Hotel, a 120-room property near the airport, is seeking a Front Desk Supervisor to lead our guest services team.

Requirements:
- At least three years of hotel experience
- Fluency in English; a second language is a plus
- Ability to work weekends

Salary is $38,000 to $44,000, depending on experience. Send a resume and cover email to Haruto Sato in Human Resources by June 14. Interviews will be held during the week of June 23.

docs.title: Email: Application for Front Desk Supervisor
docs.body:
To: Haruto Sato
From: Julia Moreno
Subject: Application for Front Desk Supervisor

Dear Mr. Sato,

I am writing to apply for the Front Desk Supervisor position. I have worked for four years at Seaview Inn, the last two as night desk lead. I speak English and Spanish, and I am available on weekends. My resume is attached.

I will be traveling from June 23 through June 25, but I can interview at any time after that.

Sincerely,
Julia Moreno

docs.title: Schedule: Front Desk Supervisor Interviews
docs.body:
Westbrook Hotel: Front Desk Supervisor Interviews

Tuesday, June 24
10:00 a.m. | Grace Liu | Mr. Sato
1:30 p.m. | Omar Haddad | Mr. Sato

Thursday, June 26
9:30 a.m. | Julia Moreno | Mr. Sato and Ms. Dubois
11:00 a.m. | Peter Kroll | Mr. Sato and Ms. Dubois

All interviews take place in Conference Room 2. Please arrive 15 minutes early and bring a photo ID. Ms. Dubois, the general manager, will join only the Thursday interviews.

questions.prompt: What is NOT required of applicants for the position?
choices: At least three years of hotel experience

evidence.quote: a second language is a plus

explain.en: The posting says a second language is only "a plus," so it is not required. Experience, English and weekend work are all listed as requirements.
explain.th: ประกาศระบุว่าภาษาที่สองเป็นเพียงข้อได้เปรียบ (a plus) ไม่ใช่ข้อบังคับ ส่วนประสบการณ์ ภาษาอังกฤษ และการทำงานวันหยุดสุดสัปดาห์เป็นคุณสมบัติที่ต้องมี

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Ms. Moreno?
choices: She exceeds the minimum experience requirement.
She has not worked in a hotel before.

evidence.quote: At least three years of hotel experience
I have worked for four years at Seaview Inn

explain.en: The posting asks for at least three years of experience, and Ms. Moreno has four. She states that she can work weekends, and nothing suggests she applied late.
explain.th: ประกาศต้องการประสบการณ์อย่างน้อย 3 ปี ส่วนคุณ Moreno ทำงานมา 4 ปี จึงเกินเกณฑ์ขั้นต่ำ เธอยังบอกว่าทำงานวันหยุดสุดสัปดาห์ได้ และไม่มีข้อมูลว่าสมัครเกินกำหนด

questions.prompt: Why was Ms. Moreno most likely scheduled for an interview on Thursday?
choices: She asked to meet Ms. Dubois.
She was unavailable earlier in the week.
Her resume arrived after the deadline.
Mr. Sato was away on Tuesday.

evidence.quote: I will be traveling from June 23 through June 25
9:30 a.m. | Julia Moreno | Mr. Sato and Ms. Dubois

explain.en: Ms. Moreno says she is traveling June 23 through 25, and her interview is on Thursday, June 26. Mr. Sato conducts the Tuesday interviews, so he was not away.
explain.th: คุณ Moreno บอกว่าเดินทางวันที่ 23-25 มิถุนายน จึงได้นัดสัมภาษณ์วันพฤหัสบดีที่ 26 ส่วนคุณ Sato สัมภาษณ์ผู้สมัครคนอื่นในวันอังคาร จึงไม่ได้ติดธุระ

questions.prompt: What are applicants asked to do before their interview?

evidence.quote: Please arrive 15 minutes early and bring a photo ID.

explain.en: The schedule asks applicants to arrive 15 minutes early and bring a photo ID. No resume, call or test is mentioned.
explain.th: ตารางนัดหมายให้ผู้สมัครมาถึงก่อน 15 นาที (arrive 15 minutes early) และนำบัตรประจำตัวมาด้วย ไม่ได้ให้ส่งเรซูเม่ โทร หรือทำแบบทดสอบ

questions.prompt: The word "held" in the job posting is closest in meaning to

evidence.quote: Interviews will be held during the week of June 23.

explain.en: Interviews that "will be held" will take place or be conducted. The other words fit physical objects, not events.
explain.th: "Held" ในที่นี้หมายถึงจัดขึ้น (conducted) เช่น การสัมภาษณ์จะจัดในสัปดาห์ของวันที่ 23 มิถุนายน ส่วนคำอื่นใช้กับการถือหรือเก็บสิ่งของ

docs.title: Webpage: TrailMate Insulated Bottle
docs.body:
TrailMate Insulated Bottle, 24 oz - $28

Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12 hours. Made from BPA-free stainless steel. Available in Slate, Forest and Coral.

Our promise: Return any unused bottle within 30 days for a full refund. All lids are covered by a one-year warranty.

Free shipping on orders over $50.

docs.title: Customer Review: TrailMate Insulated Bottle
docs.body:
Reviewed by Alan Pratt - 3 out of 5 stars

Title: Great insulation, weak lid

I bought the Forest color for hiking. The ice I put in it in the morning was still frozen that night, so I am very happy with how well it keeps drinks cold. Unfortunately, the lid cracked after six weeks of normal use. I expected better for $28.

docs.title: Email: Reply to your review
docs.body:
To: Alan Pratt
From: Customer Care, TrailMate
Subject: Reply to your review

Dear Mr. Pratt,

Thank you for your review, and we are sorry about your lid. Because the lid is under warranty, we will send you a new one at no charge. Please reply to this message with your shipping address, and the replacement will arrive within five business days.

Sincerely,
Customer Care Team
TrailMate

questions.prompt: According to the webpage, how long does the bottle keep drinks hot?

evidence.quote: Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12 hours.

explain.en: The webpage says 12 hours for hot drinks. The 24 hours is for cold drinks, and 30 is the number of return days.
explain.th: เว็บไซต์ระบุว่าเก็บความร้อนได้ 12 ชั่วโมง ส่วน 24 ชั่วโมงเป็นของเครื่องดื่มเย็น และ 30 เป็นจำนวนวันที่คืนสินค้าได้

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Pratt suggest about the bottle?
choices: It keeps drinks cold very well.
It was too expensive to buy again.
It arrived in the wrong color.

evidence.quote: I am very happy with how well it keeps drinks cold

explain.en: Mr. Pratt says the ice was still frozen that night and he is happy with the cold performance. His complaint is the lid, not the color or the cleaning.
explain.th: คุณ Pratt บอกว่าน้ำแข็งยังไม่ละลายตอนกลางคืนและพอใจกับการเก็บความเย็น ปัญหาของเขาคือฝาขวด ไม่ใช่สีหรือความยากในการล้าง

questions.prompt: Why was Mr. Pratt most likely unable to return the bottle for a full refund?
choices: He had used the bottle for longer than 30 days.
He bought it as a gift.
He did not pay for shipping.

evidence.quote: Return any unused bottle within 30 days for a full refund.
the lid cracked after six weeks of normal use

explain.en: Returns are accepted only for unused bottles within 30 days, and Mr. Pratt has used his for six weeks. Nothing is said about a gift, shipping or size.
explain.th: คืนเงินได้เฉพาะขวดที่ยังไม่ใช้ภายใน 30 วัน แต่คุณ Pratt ใช้มาแล้วหกสัปดาห์ (six weeks) จึงเกินกำหนด ไม่มีข้อมูลเรื่องของขวัญ ค่าส่ง หรือขนาดผิด

questions.prompt: What will Mr. Pratt most likely receive from the company?
choices: A new bottle in a different color

evidence.quote: the lid cracked after six weeks of normal use
we will send you a new one at no charge

explain.en: The lid cracked, and the company replies that, because it is under warranty, it will send a new lid at no charge. A refund is not offered.
explain.th: ฝาแตก และบริษัทตอบว่าเพราะฝาอยู่ในประกัน จะส่งฝาใหม่ให้ฟรี (at no charge) ไม่ได้เสนอคืนเงินหรือส่งขวดใหม่

questions.prompt: What does the company ask Mr. Pratt to do?

evidence.quote: Please reply to this message with your shipping address

explain.en: The email asks him to reply with his shipping address so the lid can be sent. It does not ask for the old lid or a changed review.
explain.th: อีเมลขอให้ตอบกลับพร้อมที่อยู่จัดส่ง (your shipping address) เพื่อส่งฝาใหม่ ไม่ได้ให้ส่งฝาเก่าคืนหรือแก้รีวิว

docs.title: Notice: Eastport Small Business Expo
docs.body:
Eastport Small Business Expo

Saturday, September 20, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Harbor Convention Hall

Join local business owners for a day of learning and networking. Workshops (40 seats each):
- Digital Marketing, 10:00 a.m.
- Bookkeeping Basics, 11:30 a.m.
- Online Sales, 1:30 p.m.

Registration is $25 through August 31 and $40 after that. Lunch is complimentary for all registered attendees. Register using the form on our website.

docs.title: Form: Expo Registration
docs.body:
Eastport Small Business Expo - Registration Form

Name: Rosa Delgado
Business: Delgado Bakery
Date submitted: September 2
Workshops selected: Bookkeeping Basics; Online Sales
Lunch preference: Vegetarian
Payment method: Credit card

docs.title: Email: Your Expo Registration
docs.body:
To: Rosa Delgado
From: Expo Team
Subject: Your Expo Registration

Dear Ms. Delgado,

Thank you for registering. Unfortunately, Bookkeeping Basics is now full. We have moved you into Digital Marketing instead, and your Online Sales seat is confirmed. If you prefer a refund of your registration fee, please let us know by September 10.

Your vegetarian lunch will be ready at noon. We look forward to seeing you.

The Expo Team

questions.prompt: Where will the expo be held?

evidence.quote: Saturday, September 20, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Harbor Convention Hall

explain.en: The notice gives Harbor Convention Hall as the location. A bakery is only Ms. Delgado's business.
explain.th: ประกาศระบุสถานที่จัดงานคือ Harbor Convention Hall ส่วนร้านเบเกอรี่เป็นธุรกิจของคุณ Delgado เท่านั้น

questions.prompt: How much did Ms. Delgado most likely pay to register?

evidence.quote: Date submitted: September 2
Registration is $25 through August 31 and $40 after that.

explain.en: She submitted the form on September 2, after the August 31 deadline for the $25 rate, so she paid $40.
explain.th: เธอส่งแบบฟอร์มวันที่ 2 กันยายน ซึ่งเลยวันที่ 31 สิงหาคมที่ราคา $25 หมดเขต จึงต้องจ่าย $40

questions.prompt: At what time will Ms. Delgado attend her first workshop?

evidence.quote: We have moved you into Digital Marketing instead
Digital Marketing, 10:00 a.m.

explain.en: Bookkeeping Basics (11:30) is full, so she was moved into Digital Marketing, which starts at 10:00 a.m. The 11:30 time was her original choice.
explain.th: เวิร์กช็อป Bookkeeping Basics (11:30) เต็ม เธอจึงถูกย้ายไป Digital Marketing ซึ่งเริ่ม 10:00 น. ส่วน 11:30 น. เป็นช่วงที่เธอเลือกไว้เดิม

questions.prompt: Why did the Expo Team send the email?
choices: To invite her to be a speaker
To tell her about a change to her registration
To ask her to pay a late fee

evidence.quote: Bookkeeping Basics is now full. We have moved you into Digital Marketing instead

explain.en: The email explains that one workshop is full and she has been moved to another, which is a change to her registration. No late fee or speaking invitation is mentioned.
explain.th: อีเมลแจ้งว่าเวิร์กช็อปหนึ่งเต็มและย้ายเธอไปอีกช่วง จึงเป็นการแจ้งการเปลี่ยนแปลงการลงทะเบียน ไม่ได้โฆษณา เชิญเป็นวิทยากร หรือเก็บค่าปรับ

questions.prompt: The word "complimentary" in the notice is closest in meaning to

evidence.quote: Lunch is complimentary for all registered attendees.

explain.en: Lunch is given to registered attendees at no cost, so "complimentary" means free of charge. It does not mean polite or optional.
explain.th: "Complimentary" ในที่นี้แปลว่าฟรี ไม่คิดค่าใช้จ่าย (free of charge) ผู้ลงทะเบียนทุกคนได้อาหารกลางวันโดยไม่เสียเงิน

docs.title: Schedule: Priya Nair, Chicago Trip Itinerary
docs.body:
Itinerary for Priya Nair, Sales Director
Client visit: Harlan Foods, Chicago

Monday, November 11
8:15 a.m. Depart Portland, Flight 52
2:40 p.m. Arrive Chicago
3:30 p.m. Hotel check-in, Lakeview Suites

Tuesday, November 12
10:00 a.m. Meeting with Harlan Foods management
1:00 p.m. Lunch with the Harlan Foods sales team
4:30 p.m. Factory tour

Wednesday, November 13
9:00 a.m. Contract review
5:20 p.m. Depart Chicago, Flight 77

Hotel details are in the attached confirmation.

docs.title: Confirmation: Lakeview Suites Reservation
docs.body:
Lakeview Suites, Chicago
Reservation Confirmation

Guest: Priya Nair
Confirmation number: LS-40817
Check-in: Monday, November 11 (from 3:00 p.m.)
Check-out: Wednesday, November 13 (by 11:00 a.m.)
Room: One king bed, $149 per night

Guests arriving after 10:00 p.m. must notify the front desk in advance, or the room may be released. A free airport shuttle runs every 30 minutes until 9:00 p.m. Breakfast is available in the restaurant for an additional $12 per guest. Reservations may be canceled free of charge up to 48 hours before check-in.

docs.title: Email: Change to your Monday flight
docs.body:
To: Priya Nair
From: Tom Reyes
Subject: Change to your Monday flight

Hi Priya,

The airline canceled Flight 52 this morning. I have rebooked you on Flight 64, which leaves Portland at 4:30 p.m. and lands in Chicago at 10:40 p.m. on the same day. Your return flight on Wednesday has not changed.

Harlan Foods also asked to start Tuesday's management meeting at 11:00 a.m. instead of the original time. I have accepted, since nothing else is scheduled before lunch.

Please tell me if you would like me to contact the hotel about your late arrival.

Tom

questions.prompt: Why did Mr. Reyes send the email?
choices: To inform Ms. Nair of changes to her travel plans
To ask Ms. Nair to approve a contract
To invite Ms. Nair to a factory tour

evidence.quote: The airline canceled Flight 52 this morning.

explain.en: Mr. Reyes reports that the flight was canceled and a meeting time changed. The hotel and the tour are not canceled or offered in the email.
explain.th: คุณ Reyes แจ้งว่าสายการบินยกเลิกเที่ยวบิน (canceled Flight 52) และเวลาประชุมเปลี่ยน อีเมลนี้จึงแจ้งการเปลี่ยนแปลงแผนเดินทาง ไม่ได้ยกเลิกโรงแรมหรือขออนุมัติสัญญา

questions.prompt: What is NOT stated about Lakeview Suites?
choices: Breakfast is included in the room rate.
The airport shuttle stops running at 9:00 p.m.
A booking can be canceled for free before the deadline.

evidence.quote: Breakfast is available in the restaurant for an additional $12 per guest.

explain.en: Breakfast costs an additional $12 per guest, so it is not included. The shuttle, check-in time and free cancellation are all stated.
explain.th: ใบยืนยันระบุว่าอาหารเช้าคิดเพิ่ม $12 ต่อคน (for an additional $12) จึงไม่รวมในค่าห้อง ส่วนรถรับส่งหยุดตอน 21.00 น. เช็กอินตั้งแต่ 15.00 น. และยกเลิกฟรีได้ภายในกำหนด

questions.prompt: What should be done because of the change to Ms. Nair's flight?
choices: The hotel should be told she will arrive late.
The Tuesday meeting should be canceled.
The hotel reservation should be extended to Thursday.
The return flight should be rebooked.

evidence.quote: lands in Chicago at 10:40 p.m. on the same day
Guests arriving after 10:00 p.m. must notify the front desk in advance

explain.en: The new flight lands at 10:40 p.m., and the hotel requires notice from guests arriving after 10:00 p.m. The return flight is explicitly unchanged.
explain.th: เที่ยวบินใหม่ถึง 22.40 น. แต่โรงแรมกำหนดให้แจ้งล่วงหน้าหากมาถึงหลัง 22.00 น. (arriving after 10:00 p.m.) จึงต้องแจ้งโรงแรม ส่วนเที่ยวบินขากลับไม่เปลี่ยน

questions.prompt: After the change, how much time will pass between the start of the Harlan Foods meeting and the lunch with the sales team?

evidence.quote: 1:00 p.m. Lunch with the Harlan Foods sales team
start Tuesday's management meeting at 11:00 a.m.

explain.en: The meeting now begins at 11:00 a.m. and lunch is at 1:00 p.m. Three hours would be the gap under the original 10:00 a.m. start.
explain.th: การประชุมเริ่ม 11.00 น. ตามอีเมล และมื้อกลางวันเริ่ม 13.00 น. ตามตารางเดินทาง จึงห่างกัน 2 ชั่วโมง ส่วน 3 ชั่วโมงคือเวลาเดิมที่เริ่ม 10.00 น.

questions.prompt: How many nights will Ms. Nair stay at the hotel?

evidence.quote: Check-in: Monday, November 11
Check-out: Wednesday, November 13

explain.en: She checks in Monday and checks out Wednesday, which is two nights. The email changes only the flight, not the hotel dates.
explain.th: เช็กอินวันจันทร์และเช็กเอาต์วันพุธ จึงพัก 2 คืน อีเมลเปลี่ยนแค่เที่ยวบิน ไม่ได้เปลี่ยนวันที่พัก

docs.title: Order Form: Greenfield Dental Clinic
docs.body:
Greenfield Dental Clinic
Office Furniture Order

Ordered by: Luis Ortega, Office Manager
Order date: August 28
Delivery requested by: September 5

Ergonomic chair, model C-200, black: 8
Standing desk, white: 2
Desk lamp, silver: 6

Special instructions: Please deliver to the rear entrance before 9:00 a.m., when the clinic opens to patients.

docs.title: Email: Problems with order #3318
docs.body:
To: Harbor Office Supply, Customer Service
From: Luis Ortega
Subject: Problems with order #3318

To whom it may concern,

Our furniture arrived on September 9, four days later than we requested. Only six chairs arrived, even though we ordered eight, and the delivery truck came at 11:00 a.m., when patients were already in the waiting area.

I would appreciate it if you could expedite the two missing chairs. Because the delivery was late, I also ask that you remove the delivery charge from our bill before we pay it.

Please reply by Friday.

Luis Ortega
Greenfield Dental Clinic

questions.prompt: Why did Mr. Ortega write the email?
choices: To report problems with an order

evidence.quote: Only six chairs arrived, even though we ordered eight

explain.en: He describes a late delivery and missing chairs and asks for corrections. He does not cancel, praise or request prices.
explain.th: คุณ Ortega เล่าว่าส่งช้าและเก้าอี้มาไม่ครบ (only six chairs arrived) พร้อมขอให้แก้ไข อีเมลนี้จึงเป็นการแจ้งปัญหาเกี่ยวกับคำสั่งซื้อ ไม่ได้ยกเลิกหรือชม

questions.prompt: What did the clinic ask for in its special instructions?
choices: Delivery to the rear entrance before 9:00 a.m.
A separate invoice for each item

evidence.quote: Please deliver to the rear entrance before 9:00 a.m.

explain.en: The order form asks for rear-entrance delivery before 9:00 a.m. The 30-day payment term comes from the invoice, not the clinic's instructions.
explain.th: ใบสั่งซื้อระบุให้ส่งที่ประตูหลังก่อน 9.00 น. (rear entrance before 9:00 a.m.) ส่วนกำหนดชำระ 30 วันอยู่ในใบแจ้งหนี้ ไม่ใช่คำขอของคลินิก

questions.prompt: How many chairs does Harbor Office Supply still need to deliver?

evidence.quote: Ergonomic chair, model C-200, black: 8
Ergonomic chair, model C-200    6
Only six chairs arrived

explain.en: The order form asks for eight chairs, while the invoice and the email show six delivered. That leaves two. Six is the number already delivered.
explain.th: สั่ง 8 ตัว (order form) แต่ใบแจ้งหนี้และอีเมลยืนยันว่าส่งมา 6 ตัว จึงขาดอีก 2 ตัว ส่วน 6 คือจำนวนที่ส่งแล้ว

questions.prompt: Which charge on the invoice does Mr. Ortega ask to have removed?

evidence.quote: remove the delivery charge from our bill
Delivery charge                                $45

explain.en: He asks that the delivery charge be removed from the bill, and the invoice shows that charge is $45. The other amounts are for items he received.
explain.th: เขาขอให้ตัดค่าจัดส่งออกจากบิล (remove the delivery charge) และใบแจ้งหนี้ระบุค่าจัดส่ง $45 ส่วนยอดอื่นเป็นค่าสินค้าที่ได้รับแล้ว

questions.prompt: The word "expedite" in the second paragraph of the email is closest in meaning to

evidence.quote: I would appreciate it if you could expedite the two missing chairs.

explain.en: Asking the company to expedite the missing chairs means to deliver them faster. Nothing in the sentence asks for an inspection or a refund.
explain.th: expedite คือเร่งให้เร็วขึ้น (speed up) เพราะคุณ Ortega อยากได้เก้าอี้ที่ขาดโดยเร็ว ไม่ได้ขอตรวจสอบหรือคืนเงิน

docs.title: Chat: Mia Santos and Ben Carver
docs.body:
Mia Santos (10:12 A.M.): Did you read Hana's memo about the training?
Ben Carver (10:14 A.M.): Yes. They moved the computer session to Room 3C.
Mia Santos (10:15 A.M.): I'm more worried about Wednesday. I have a client call at 2:00 p.m. that day.
Ben Carver (10:17 A.M.): Then the role-play will run right over it, won't it?
Mia Santos (10:18 A.M.): It will. I'll ask Hana what I can do.
Ben Carver (10:19 A.M.): Good idea. Certificates only go to people who attend everything.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the memo?
choices: To announce changes to the training schedule
To register staff for the training
To explain how to use the CRM software

evidence.quote: the Team Role-Play session will take place from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. that day

explain.en: The memo moves the CRM session to another room and the role-play to the afternoon. It names no new trainer and asks for no registration.
explain.th: บันทึกแจ้งย้ายห้องของเซสชัน CRM และย้ายเวลา Team Role-Play จึงเป็นการแจ้งเปลี่ยนตารางอบรม ไม่ได้แนะนำวิทยากรใหม่หรือรับลงทะเบียน

questions.prompt: At 10:17 A.M., what does Mr. Carver most likely mean when he writes, "Then the role-play will run right over it, won't it?"
choices: The session will overlap with Ms. Santos's client call.
The role-play will be shorter than planned.
The client call should be canceled.
Ms. Santos has already missed the role-play.

evidence.quote: Then the role-play will run right over it, won't it?
I have a client call at 2:00 p.m. that day.

explain.en: Ms. Santos mentions a 2:00 p.m. call, and the role-play now runs 1:00 to 4:00 p.m. 'Run over it' means the two events conflict. Nothing suggests the session is shorter or the call is canceled.
explain.th: Mia มีนัดโทร 14.00 น. ส่วน role-play ย้ายมาเป็น 13.00-16.00 น. 'run right over it' จึงหมายถึงเวลาทับกัน ไม่ได้บอกว่าสั้นลงหรือให้ยกเลิกสาย

questions.prompt: Which session will Ms. Santos most likely need to ask to attend at another time?

evidence.quote: the Team Role-Play session will take place from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. that day
I have a client call at 2:00 p.m. that day.

explain.en: The memo moves the role-play to Wednesday afternoon, which overlaps her 2:00 p.m. client call. The CRM session also moved, but only its room changed.
explain.th: เซสชัน Team Role-Play ถูกย้ายเป็นบ่ายวันพุธ ซึ่งทับกับสาย 14.00 น. ของ Mia ส่วนเซสชัน CRM เปลี่ยนแค่ห้อง ไม่ได้เปลี่ยนเวลา

questions.prompt: At what time will the session in Room 3C begin?

evidence.quote: The CRM Software session will be held in Room 3C at the same time.
9:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m. CRM Software (Room 4B)

explain.en: The memo moves CRM Software to Room 3C at the same time, and the schedule lists that session on Tuesday at 9:00 a.m.
explain.th: บันทึกบอกว่าเซสชัน CRM ย้ายไป Room 3C ในเวลาเดิม และตารางระบุว่าเริ่มวันอังคาร 9.00 น. จึงตอบวันอังคาร 9.00 น.

questions.prompt: What is NOT indicated about the training?
choices: Certificates will be given to everyone who registers.
Staff should bring a laptop on Tuesday.
The final assessment is on Thursday.
Staff who cannot attend should contact Ms. Lindqvist.

evidence.quote: Certificates will be given only to staff who attend every session.

explain.en: Certificates go only to staff who attend every session, not to everyone who registers. The other statements appear in the schedule or the memo.
explain.th: ใบรับรองให้เฉพาะคนที่เข้าครบทุกเซสชัน (only to staff who attend every session) ไม่ใช่ทุกคนที่ลงทะเบียน ส่วนข้ออื่นมีระบุในตารางหรือบันทึก
